title: Filter groups with HAVING
prompt: Find departments with more than 2 encounters. Return department and visit_count.
starterSql:
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM encounters
GROUP BY department
hints: WHERE filters rows; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY.
Use HAVING with aggregate conditions like COUNT(*) > 2.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM encounters GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
